newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - J.P. Morgan EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - J.P. Morgan EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Diane Glossman said she cut the 1996 estimate for J.P. Morgan & Co Inc to $7.60 per share from $7.70, and cut the 1997 estimate to $7.70 per share from $8.35
-- Hold rating is unchanged, analyst says

-- Regarding Q3 results reported earlier Thursday, Glossman said, "I was expecting the trading would not match the record-setting performance of the first half." She added, "Investment banking continues to show strong headway. While the company continues to work hard on expense control, I think that will continue to be a challenge going into next year."
